name: qdro-drafter
description: Use this skill when a U.S. matrimonial attorney or QDRO specialist needs to draft a retirement-division order — QDRO (ERISA), COAP (CSRS/FERS), TSP RBCO, MPDO (USFSPA), or governmental DRO. Produces a plan-typed DRAFT order with survivor-benefit election, award formula, and pre-approval cover letter for attorney review before court entry.
